behavior.empty_inputs: Null, empty and unbound inputs omit their own Mustache sections. Missing Answer hides entry and hints without throwing.
behavior.accepted_answers:
Each rendered array item is one complete transcript alternative. Word matching selects a consistent transcript; a mixture of incompatible alternatives cannot pass. Array boundaries are read from existing DOM
nodes. Only template JavaScript tokenizes words.
behavior.normalization: NFC and case insensitive. Boundary punctuation is supplied by the transcript and optional when typing; accents, tone marks, internal apostrophes and internal hyphens remain significant.
behavior.character_count: One compact dash per Unicode grapheme, ordinary spaces and supplied punctuation between words. A borderless passage wraps naturally and scrolls only when very long; one small editor handles the active word.
behavior.hints: Reveal one grapheme of the active word per click through its final character. Hints do not fill the input or mark a word correct.
behavior.audio: No autoplay. Dictation plays on the front only on click; other templates expose native controls on the back.
behavior.back: Uses the same card width, padding, mode heading and prompt/media geometry as the front. Keep the prompt or image in place; put the answer next, then immediately related reading/meaning/translation, followed by explanations, paired examples and notes. Dictation repeats the front audio button and compact borderless word typography. Optional empty inputs hide independently; no correctness verdict.
behavior.grading: Flip the card and choose the study rating.
behavior.keyboard: An exact word automatically advances without Space, Enter or a commit button. Valid partial prefixes stay neutral; incompatible input turns red and shakes once per mistake. Space after an automatic advance is ignored. Enter can skip a word for later correction. Click a word to restore its attempted text; empty-editor Backspace returns to the previous word. IME composition never advances; paste accepts multiple words including a correct final word.
behavior.correction: Mistakes remain visible as red x masks and can be clicked to retype. Exact correction advances to the next unfinished word. CSS feedback respects reduced motion. Extra pasted words stay incorrect until removed. Hints alone cannot complete the exercise; all words must belong to one accepted transcript.
